ENTITLED:“A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING SUBMISSION OF AN
UNDER THE BUSINESS READY COMMUNITY GRANT AND

REDUCTION GRANT NOT TO EXCEED $2,250,000 ON BEHALF
OF THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE."
FOR THE PURPOSE OF: REDUCING THE COMMUNICATIONS AND UTILITY
COSTS THROUGH THE REIMBURSEMENT OF ACCRUED UTILITY EXPENSES
AND ENCOURAGING EMPLOYMENT AND PRIVATE INVESTMENT BY
PROJECT BISON.
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne desires to participate in
the Business Ready Community Grant and Loan Program to assist infinancing this project;
and
WHEREAS, the Business Ready Community Grant and Loan Program requires
that certain criteria be met, as described in the Wyoming Business Council's Rules
governing theprogram, andto thebest of our knowledge this application meets those
criteria; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne recognizes that the
project will create jobs, business development, and public benefits and/or improve
infrastructure within the boundaries of the City of Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, the public benefit(s)of thisproject is increased payroll andproperty
taxes and the consideration is the number of new employees, total payroll, and capital
investment; and
WHEREAS, the specific goals and measures of success of this project are the
direct and indirect economic development benchmarks, project capital investments,
number of jobs created and retained at a pay rate that is at least 150% of the county's
medianwage; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne held a public hearing on August 16, 2021 to
solicit testimony from citizens, and gave full consideration to all comments received.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF
the City of Cheyenne, that a grant application in the amount of$2,250,000 be submitted to
the Wyoming Business Council for consideration of assistance in funding Project Bison.
1:
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Mayor and City Clerkare authorized to
execute all documents associated with the grant award, and that the City of Cheyenne
Grants Manager or designee, be appointed as agent for the City of Cheyenne to submit
applications and certifications for these funds and to receive funds and implement the
programs funded under this grant as approved by the City of Cheyenne Governing Body
and consistent with this Resolution.
